Package ru.postgrespro.perf.pgmicrobench.statanalyzer.sequences

Mathematical sequences and progression generators.

This package provides implementations of mathematical sequences used throughout the library for various purposes such as grid generation, parameter sampling, and numerical methods.

Available sequences:

  • ArithmeticProgressionSequence - Arithmetic progression (linear sequence)

Common use cases:

  • Generating evaluation points for function plotting
  • Creating parameter grids for optimization
  • Generating test points for numerical integration
  • Creating bin edges for histograms

Future extensions may include geometric progressions, logarithmic sequences, and other specialized sequence generators.
